unlisted_practices: Correlating multimodal digital biomarkers (speech, vision, language features) from LLM conversations with validated depression, fatigue, and cognition measures
Assessing feasibility and user experience of a remote conversational AI check-in platform in an operational military population

screen.reason: This feasibility observational study deployed an LLM-powered conversational platform (Okaya) to participants in the US military to extract multimodal digital biomarkers for mental health and fatigue. It assesses feasibility and correlations, not a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
